name: 宋秉文
title: 台灣脊髓小腦運動失調症研究的奠基者
orgs: 台北榮總神經醫學中心（1988 年於此建立全國第一個神經基因實驗室）；晚年任台北醫學大學雙和醫院神經科、台北神經醫學中心
body: 台灣 SCA 臨床與基因研究的開創者。1988 年在台北榮總建立全國第一個神經基因實驗室，為 SCA22 的命名者；創立台灣神經罕見疾病學會並任首任理事長，亦為台灣神經學學會神經基因學組創始主委。2001 年中華小腦萎縮症病友協會即在其鼓勵與協助下成立。2018 年促成 SRCA 世界大會在台北舉辦。病中以單指打字完成《小腦萎縮症的臨床試驗》一書（2023 年出版）。2023 年 11 月 1 日辭世，享壽 70 歲；同年 12 月 16 日，台灣神經學學會、台灣神經罕見疾病學會與台北榮總神經內科於北榮致德樓合辦紀念學術研討會。
note: 本平台保留此頁，是因為台灣 SCA 的臨床網絡、學會組織與病友社群多可追溯至他；亦提醒使用者：仍將其列為現任醫師的名單皆屬過時資料。

en.title: Founder of spinocerebellar ataxia research in Taiwan
en.orgs: Neurological Institute, Taipei Veterans General Hospital (where he established Taiwan's first neurogenetics laboratory in 1988); later Shuang Ho Hospital and Taipei Neuroscience Institute, Taipei Medical University
en.body: The founding figure of clinical and genetic SCA research in Taiwan. In 1988 he established the country's first neurogenetics laboratory at Taipei Veterans General Hospital, and he named SCA22. He founded the Society for Neurological Rare Disorders–Taiwan and served as its first president, and was the founding convenor of the neurogenetics section of the Taiwan Neurological Society. The Taiwan Spinocerebellar Ataxia Association was established in 2001 with his encouragement and help, and he brought the SRCA world congress to Taipei in 2018. While ill he typed a book on SCA clinical trials with one finger, published in 2023. He died on 1 November 2023, aged 70; on 16 December that year the Taiwan Neurological Society, SNERD and TVGH Neurology jointly held a memorial symposium at TVGH.
en.note: This page exists because Taiwan's SCA clinical network, professional societies and patient community can largely be traced back to him — and as a reminder that any roster still listing him as a practising physician is out of date.
